text:
maria-docs: quick sync: platform is retiring the old streaming shim and renaming a couple SDK params in v3. need a small migration guide, updated examples (node + py), and a docs redirect. target freeze for docs is 2026-04-15. can we split tasks? :clipboard:
aj-platform: i can take the migration guide and the redirect entries. question: do we list both internal and public rollback steps, or keep rollback internal only?
maria-docs: include public rollback guidance (pin-to-version + fallback to non-streaming) but redact enterprise-only rollback procedures. jen-legal: ok on that. add a short risk blurb for the email.
devrel_tom: i'll rewrite the node + python snippets. heads-up: v3 SDK changes `emit_partial` -> `partial_mode` and `on_stream` -> `stream_handler`. those will 400 on old v1 endpoints after cutoff. i'll include both the pre/post examples.
aj-platform: added: also need a note about model alias swap for embeddings: `redwood/synth-embed` -> `redwood/emb-lite`. customers using pinned aliases should get a migration snippet.
maria-docs: good catch. include an example that shows `model: 'redwood/emb-lite@2026-04-01'` pinning and a fallback to `embeddings.create()` if streaming fails.
ci-bot: docs-ci status: branch docs/streaming-migration (checks: 8/8) — smoke tests queued.
devrel_tom: node snippet for new v3 streaming handler:
```js
// examples/node/stream-handler.js
const resStream = await client.responses.stream({
  model: 'redwood/fast-chat',
  input: 'Tail the server logs and summarize errors',
  partial_mode: 'tokens',
  stream_handler: (chunk) => {
    if (chunk.type === 'delta') process.stdout.write(chunk.delta.content || '')
  },
})
await resStream.finished()
```
jen-legal: pls avoid promising uptime in the public email. keep the wording migration-only and include links to support.
maria-docs: noted. draft announcement blurb for site/email: "The legacy streaming shim will be retired on 2026-04-22. Please migrate to SDK v3 streaming (param renames: `emit_partial` -> `partial_mode`, `on_stream` -> `stream_handler`) and to emb-lite for embeddings. See migration guide and examples for code samples and pin/fallback patterns." feedback?
aj-platform: change date to 2026-04-21 (we want a weekend buffer). also ask infra to keep the v1 endpoints readable but not writable for 48h after cutoff so customers can inspect failures.
maria-docs: i'll ping infra separately. devrel, please include a tiny smoke test for node that asserts non-empty stdout, and a python test that asserts the response object has `.deltas` list.
devrel_tom: yep — will add tests. python example:
```py
# examples/python/stream_handler.py
res = client.responses.stream(
    model='redwood/fast-chat',
    input='Analyze recent deploy logs',
    partial_mode='tokens',
    stream_handler=lambda chunk: print(chunk.get('delta', {}).get('content', ''), end='')
)
res.wait()
```
aj-platform: for redirects: add `/v1/streaming` -> `/docs/migrate/streaming-shim` and add a banner on the runtime index. i'll open a PR with the redirect and banner copy.
ci-bot: lint check failed on branch devrel/stream-snippets (1/8). failing file: examples/node/stream-handler.js - missing newline at EOF.
devrel_tom: fixing now.
maria-docs: last items: 1) include a short FAQ Q/A on partial token semantics (why order might differ), 2) add a note that embeddings dimension is unchanged but model name differs, 3) link to the SDK changelog. tag me when PRs are ready.
aj-platform: opened PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4999 - includes redirect + migration guide draft.
devrel_tom: pushed snippets + tests in https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/5001. please review.
jen-legal: reviewed the announcement blurb and added a line about contacting support for account-specific exemptions.
maria-docs: thank you all. i'll merge the banner + email copy after PR reviews and schedule the announcement for 2026-04-21 17:00 UTC. please ensure CI green and smoke tests pass. :rocket:
